defs.def: worried about what might happen 担心（会发生某事）

ex.s: I'm afraid I won't be able to meet you this time, but you'll always be my dear friend.
ex.t: 恐怕这次我见不到你了，但你永远是我亲爱的朋友。

ex.s: Some people stopped swimming in the sea, afraid of the horrible creature from the film.
ex.t: 有些人停止在海里游泳，害怕电影中的可怕生物。

ex.s: Only around six people are killed by sharks every year.Fortunately, not everyone who watched the film Jaws became afraid of sharks - some became interested in understanding them.
ex.t: 每年只有大约六人被鲨鱼杀死。幸运的是，并不是每个看过电影《大白鲨》的人都害怕鲨鱼，有些人开始有兴趣了解它们。

ex.s: You’re right,… I'm afraid… Well,… Student B You are a customer.

ex.s: I’m afraid that I have to disagree.
